purpose: automatically group locally planar connected UV-less faces into deterministic padded charts and bake verified UC material maps into a native offline atlas
limitations: Offline connected-planar fallback only; no global seam optimization, density-optimal packing, UDIMs, high-to-low cage baking, AO/curvature/thickness synthesis or MikkTSpace parity.
Hard edges, disconnected topology and nonmanifold adjacency remain seams instead of being silently merged.
Generated chart separation and pixel gutters are technical evidence, not aesthetic acceptance.
Sources and failed product drafts remain preserved; existing outputs are refused.
